assumptions.empty.title: No assumptions recorded

assumptions.unknownField: {{field}} was left undecided, so the default value is still in the model.
assumptions.engine.growth: Revenue grows {{rate}}% every month from each stream's start month.
assumptions.engine.ramp: The earliest revenue stream starts in month {{month}}.
assumptions.engine.payrollFixed: Payroll is held at face value in every scenario — headcount is a commitment, not a scenario variable.
assumptions.engine.fixedCostScenario: The pessimistic case multiplies recurring costs by {{multiplier}}.
assumptions.engine.tax: Tax is charged at {{rate}}% of positive operating profit only.
assumptions.engine.discount: Net present value discounts cash flow at {{rate}}% a year.
assumptions.engine.workingCapital: Working capital equal to {{months}} months of revenue is tied up in the business.

assumptions.engine.noInflation: Prices and costs are held in today's money apart from each stream's own growth rate.
assumptions.engine.debt: Loans carry {{rate}}% a year with a {{grace}}-month grace period before repayment.
assumptions.engine.scenarioSpread: Scenarios assume roughly {{optimistic}}% upside and {{pessimistic}}% downside on revenue.
